reason: A Codex Skill and DeepSeek Harness plugin that optionally simulates a brief pause, summarizes observable task state, and resumes the agent workflow.

summaries.zh: 一个可选地让智能体短暂“走神”、回顾可观察任务状态并继续执行的 Codex Skill 与 DeepSeek Harness 插件。
summaries.en: A Codex Skill and DeepSeek Harness plugin that optionally simulates a brief pause, recaps observable task state, and resumes the agent workflow.

capabilities: Injects brief behavioral prompts at agent step boundaries
Reads observable session event state to generate task-progress recap
Uses timing estimates and randomness to schedule optional interruptions
